title: lab-notebook: auditor subagent + nb audit bundle (was phase 5)

notes.author: Dylan Wichman/7dfeebce
notes.text: Decided with user 2026-11-09: nb audit <con> gathers the conclusion, its results, each source experiment frozen design with its rule and deviations, uncited sibling results, results added later, and other conclusions on the same question. A fresh read-only subagent runs the audit (Sonnet by default, configurable). It checks: backed, rule-faithful, scoped, one claim, not cherry-picked, consistent, alternatives. It runs automatically on a pending conclusion before confirm. /nb-audit runs a graph-wide sweep that records an audit on each conclusion involved; structural checks stay in lint. The auditor returns findings and the main agent records them with nb add audit, ungated.
